summary.text: Cheryl Hilton is the Democratic candidate for Connecticut House of Representatives District 80 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Gale Mastrofrancesco.
A Southington resident and realtor, she describes her campaign as focused on listening, affordability and strong communities.

paragraphs.text: Cheryl Hilton earned a high school diploma from Southington High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Connecticut in 1991, and her career experience includes working as a realtor.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a longtime Southington resident, realtor, community advocate and educator, and said the district she is seeking to represent covers Wolcott and part of Southington.
Hilton did not face a Democratic primary; the August 11, 2026 primary was canceled.
In the survey, Hilton named affordability, housing, education, economic opportunity and support for seniors and families as her policy interests.
She said she has been endorsed by the Connecticut AFL-CIO and State Representative Larry Butler.
